lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走，脚步很沉。
lines.en: I walk the fallen leaves with heavy feet.
My wings shrank away; walking is all I have.
The furnace in my belly gurgles as I go.

lines.zh: 木头在胃里烧，走起来发烫。
lines.en: Wood burns in my gut; walking makes me hot.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是不想碾到东西。
lines.en: I walk slowly so I do not crush anything.
Every step of mine raises a little ash.
I steer around the thickest deadwood.

lines.zh: 地面一热，我就换个方向。
lines.en: When the ground warms, I change direction.

lines.zh: 我闻到自己身上的焦味。
lines.en: I can smell scorch coming off my own hide.
The trees are thick; I squeeze through sideways.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有烟，我咳了一声。
lines.en: Smoke sits in my throat; I cough once.
I do not fly, though I look like a bird.
Charcoal underfoot; it breaks still warm.

lines.zh: 走远些，这里我待太久了。
lines.en: I should move on; I have lingered too long.

lines.zh: 我肚子里响，走一步抖一下。
lines.en: My stomach rumbles, and every step jolts it.

lines.zh: 我踩过一堆炭，炉子更旺了。
lines.en: I step over a coal pile and my furnace burns hotter.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，让炉子歇一会。
lines.en: I crouch down and let the furnace rest.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有一点火苗在跳。
lines.en: A small flame flickers at the back of my throat.
I keep quiet; noise makes things happen.
An empty belly is the most dangerous state.

lines.zh: 我盯着林子，怕它先着火。
lines.en: I watch the woods, afraid they will catch first.

lines.zh: 身上的热气把草熏黄了。
lines.en: My body heat has yellowed the grass around me.
I am counting how much charcoal is left.

lines.zh: 风吹过羽毛，灰落了一地。
lines.en: Wind stirs my feathers and ash falls away.

lines.zh: 我慢慢吞下一块干木头。
lines.en: I slowly swallow one dry piece of wood.
Do not light me; I would rather not burn.
When all is quiet, the fire behaves itself.

lines.zh: 我听着自己体内噼啪作响。
lines.en: I listen to the crackling inside my own chest.
Take that torch a good deal farther away.
I mean you no harm, truly none.
You smell faintly of charcoal to me.
I am backing off because I fear you.
Do not come near me holding that.
There is fire in my eyes; do not misread it.
Is that coal in your hand, or wood?
Stop staring or I will fold myself small.
Stand quietly, and I can settle down.
These wings of mine are only decoration.
That one landed on the plate along my side.
I pull back; I do not want to fight.
The pain tightens my throat right up.
Not the belly; the furnace is burning there.

lines.zh: 几根焦羽落下来，还冒烟。
lines.en: A few scorched feathers fall, still smoking.
That blow makes me want to spray fire.
I am holding it in; truly I am.
You are striking far too close to me.
One more and I will not be able to stop.
I stumbled once, but I did not fall.
Could I have that length of log?
Coal suits my stomach better than anything.
Do not toss that wood; leave it for me.
That wood is too new and still damp.
I smell something dry and rather fine.
I do not eat meals; I only burn fuel.
Give me a little more and I can walk.
That is not wood; do not fool me.
Every stick in your hand, I want all of it.
Feeding me is safer than setting me alight.
Do not bump me; I run hot to the touch.
Keep clear of me; I am heavier than I look.
That shove knocked me badly off balance.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛蹭到你的袖子。
lines.en: My feathers brushed against your sleeve.
Do not crowd me; I startle easily.
Bumping my belly is a truly bad idea.
I turn aside to let you pass; hurry.
My bones are sharp; I apologize for that.
That knock sent ash up into the air.
I take two steps back; do not follow.
I would rather my fire not reach you.
Slowly, please; I am a timid creature.

lines.zh: 背脊的甲片一碰就烫手。
lines.en: The plates along my spine burn at a touch.
Let us simply crouch here side by side.
You are cool to the touch; that is good.
I keep my distance from fiery tempers.
Any closer and I fear we both burn.

lines.zh: 你愿意留在这片林子吗？
lines.en: Would you stay in this forest with me?

lines.zh: 我的叫声像柴火爆开，很轻。
lines.en: My call sounds like a stick popping, softly.
This season the woods are far too dry.
I hold this lump of charcoal in my beak.
I gather wood; the stones I leave alone.
This one on the ground is still warm.

lines.zh: 这根木头，我用喙夹稳了。
lines.en: I clamp this log firmly in my beak.
Soggy firewood is of no use to me.
With charcoal in my beak, I can only nod.
This one will keep me burning a while.
I set it down and choose a better stick.
Your belongings stay put; I take nothing.
Carry too much and I shed ash everywhere.
Something is coming; I crouch down first.
That is not prey; that is a threat.
I have it marked, but I do not want to fight.
Those steps are too even; a hunter.
I see iron; time for me to leave.
I make note of my way out first.
Someone is behind that tree; stay quiet.
It is eyeing my young; that will not do.
I recognize that particular shield.
One wrong move and I will spray.
I puff myself up to look much larger.
The back of my throat is already heating.
One more step and I lose control.
This is a warning; do not pretend otherwise.
I scan for the narrowest way out.
If you back off, I will hold the fire.
Every feather on my body stands up.
When cornered, I do very foolish things.
Do not press us back against the trees.
This breath is very hard to swallow down.
I peck at you only to drive you off.
This charge is clumsy and very heavy.
My wing swings across and raises ash.
I did not want this; you forced it.
My claws rake once through the soil.

lines.zh: 这一下只擦过你的护腿。
lines.en: That only grazed the edge of your leggings.
My strikes come hurried and badly aimed.
Do not hit back; I am retreating now.
The heat coming off me is rising fast.
That bite landed on wood, not on you.
I rise up out of the scorched earth.
These woods have gone dry and brittle.

lines.zh: 我出生时，周围还冒着烟。
lines.en: When I was born, smoke still hung around.
The fire in my gut has just caught.

lines.zh: 我站起来，抖落一层黑灰。
lines.en: I stand and shake off a layer of black ash.
Who lit a fire in this place before?
I smell scorching, and it is familiar.
Not too close; I have only just woken.
I have memorized this particular hillside now.
The moment I landed, the grass curled.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，我就是炉子。
lines.en: Fire does nothing to me; I am a furnace.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我压到了翅膀。
lines.en: I landed hard and crushed my own wing.

lines.zh: 水泼上来，我喉咙嘶嘶响。
lines.en: Water hits me and my throat hisses.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻了，炉子还烧着。
lines.en: The blast flipped me over; the furnace still burns.
An arrow wedged in my armor seam.

lines.zh: 法术压住了我体内的火。
lines.en: Magic is smothering the fire inside me.

lines.zh: 没木头可烧，我越来越冷。
lines.en: No wood left to burn; I grow colder.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我身上全是火。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I caught all over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有空气，火灭了。
lines.en: No air in the void; my fire goes out.
